historical_reviews.deepseek: It recognizes a remote hazardous state change but covers only activation and leaves secrets, target and fallback under-specified.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly separates enforcement from policy definition and makes remote attribution and recovery prerequisites.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run location was searched and excluded as authority; the IB activation and power-limit set/get cases were compared only to isolate route, stored-policy and enforcement coverage.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Remote enforcement can disrupt both workload and the management path relied on for reversal, so the restore channel must be independently available before the write.

original_test_intent: Activate or deactivate the previously configured DCMI power-limit policy on the intended BMC over LANPlus, verify effective enforcement and safely restore the prior state even if the remote path becomes unavailable.
original_method: Retain the exact OOB raw 0x2c/0x05 state change, adding immutable target/session proof, secret-safe transport, complete policy baseline, effective-state evidence and independent fallback recovery.
manual_activity: The owner approves the endpoint, exact 0x00/0x01 state, complete armed policy and action risk, dedicated idle SUT, maintenance window, alternate console/power path and restoration to the recorded baseline.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Approved cipher and secret-safe credential source
safety_requirements: Protect credentials from argv and evidence
Do not combine with Set Power Limit
One state change and no automatic retry
Ensure fallback does not depend on the changed policy path
agent_execution_scope: Bind BMC endpoint to intended hardware
Read complete policy and state baseline
Validate requested state and armed action
Confirm workload and independent fallback health
Verify effective state and system health
engineer_actions: Approve endpoint, state, armed-policy risk and independent recovery
Confirm configured limit is safe to enforce or protection is safe to remove

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level `activate` covers only 0x01, displays the password on argv and does not prove raw state encoding, 0x00 deactivation, target identity or effective-state verification.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After immutable target and fallback validation, use secret-safe LANPlus transport to issue raw 0x2c 0x05 0xdc <approved-0x00-or-0x01> 0 0 once, then independently read policy/state, observe bounded effects and restore the recorded state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The OOB route, opcode, activation encodings and 10/5 timing remain; endpoint, cipher, state, policy and observation bounds are approved rather than inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute an identity-bound remote enforcement-state transaction with secret-safe access, full policy/state baseline, one approved branch, independent effect verification and recovery that survives loss of the OOB session.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds remote attribution, secret controls, two-branch coverage, effective-state acceptance and independent recovery beyond response echo.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: IB activation does not cover remote identity/session failure; Set/Get Power Limit do not prove enforcement; a high-level activate wrapper omits deactivation and raw framing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Activation can throttle or hard-power off the host and may interrupt the route used to reverse it; deactivation removes protection; wrong-target LANPlus access can affect another server.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor API is equivalent only when immutable target proof, both state values, armed-policy semantics, effective-state evidence and independent recovery are preserved; omitted LANPlus/raw coverage must be disclosed.
expected_evidence: Immutable SUT/BMC endpoint and redacted secret-safe session identity
Complete configured policy and activation baseline
Approval for exact state and armed action
Workload quiescence plus independent console/power fallback
Exact OOB activation request/response and completion
Independent effective-state, policy and bounded power/workload/SEL evidence
Restore through approved path and final route/system health
No credential leakage or unrelated mutation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, prerequisite, LANPlus raw command and state map consistently describe OOB activation/deactivation. The byte-2 criterion is insufficient as proof of effective state but does not contradict the named operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The route and two state values are identifiable. Endpoint, access, configured policy, approval, workload safety and independent recovery are concrete prerequisites.

review_improvement: Makes remote enforcement activation attributable, secret-safe, two-directional and recoverable without trusting the same OOB path to remain available.
independent_technical_reasoning: An OOB activation command can trigger a policy that powers off or throttles the server, and that effect can invalidate the management session used for readback or reversal. Safe automation must prove the endpoint before the change and prove an independent fallback path before relying on LANPlus. The `dc` echo cannot demonstrate enforcement; complete policy/state readback plus bounded workload, power and SEL evidence is required, followed by restoration without automatic retry.
